page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.6xlarge is a big data and storage-focused instance designed for data-intensive processing and high-capacity storage retention. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 12 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It includes 33 MB of L3 cache, 96.0 GB of memory (4.0 GB per vCPU core), and an integrated local storage array totaling 70,866 GB of HDD capacity. Network connectivity is supported by a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, while hardware accelerators are absent with zero GPUs configured.

Benchmark outcomes show standard multi-core throughput alongside modest single-thread capabilities, typical of the Broadwell-era processor family. In stress-ng evaluations, the single-core score of 1,107.59 ranks in the bottom 25%, while multi-core performance reaches 17,639.99 in the middle 50%. Geekbench testing mirrors this separation, recording 955.0 points in single-core and 7,235.0 points in multi-core metrics. PassMark benchmarks place overall CPU performance at 18,256.63 and memory operations at 1,834.39, reflecting stable parallel capability with uncached memory write bandwidth achieving 45.96 GB/sec.

Hardware tradeoffs center around high spindle-disk storage capacity at the expense of per-core latency. The instance provides substantial storage density via 70.8 TB of HDD space, but sequential compression and single-core tasks execute slowly, as illustrated by a poor gzip compression rating of 18.97 GB/sec. Large-capacity mechanical drives paired with moderate compute deliver cost-effective capacity scaling for bulk datasets that do not justify high-cost NVMe or massive memory footprints.

Workload fit focuses on big data analytics frameworks, distributed file systems, batch processing, log ingestion clusters, and long-term analytical databases. The server is well positioned for Apache Hadoop, HDFS nodes, data warehousing ETL pipelines, and high-throughput static data retrieval that benefits from balanced 16 Gbps networking coupled with high local volume capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne.6xlarge is a big data server configuration equipped with 24 dedicated vCPUs (12 physical cores) running on an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor at 2.5 GHz, paired with 96.0 GB of system memory and 70,866 GB of local HDD storage. Network throughput operates at a baseline of 16 Gbps without GPU hardware. Benchmark results demonstrate reliable parallel processing throughput, marked by a PassMark CPU rating of 18,256.63 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 84.19 GB/sec, alongside modest single-thread performance indicated by a Geekbench single-core score of 955.0. Combining deep local HDD volume with a standard 1:4 core-to-memory ratio, this instance is suited for batch processing, Hadoop/HDFS data nodes, distributed log collection, and cost-efficient big data analytics architectures.
